title: Bacon-Wrapped Tater Tots
description: Potato nuggets are stuffed with Cheddar cheese and wrapped in bacon for a crowd-pleasing party food.
ingredients: 12 slices center-cut bacon, cut in half crosswise
24 frozen bite-sized potato nuggets (such as Tater Tots®), partially defrosted
4 slices sharp Cheddar cheese, each cut into 6 small pieces
3 teaspoons hot pepper sauce (such as Frank's RedHot®), or to taste

steps.text: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Lay each slice of bacon onto a work surface. Place a potato nugget in the center of each bacon slice.
Cut a slit down the center of each potato nugget and place a piece of Cheddar cheese into the slit. Top each nugget with a dash of hot sauce.
Wrap bacon around each nugget, secure with a toothpick, and transfer to the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until nuggets are cooked through and bacon is crispy, 15 to 20 minutes.
